n66cf44ad74.headline: India to become 5th largest economy in 2025, 3rd largest by 2030
n66cf44ad74.summary: India is expected to rise from 6th place in 2020 to 5th largest economy by 2025 and 3rd largest by 2030, having overtaken the UK in 2019.
n66cf44ad74.why: India's rapid economic growth and demographic advantages position it as a major global economic power, impacting global trade, investment, and markets.
